newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai passenger Nov car imports fall sharply yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Thai passenger Nov car imports fall sharply yr/yr.

text.p: Thailand's passenger car imports fell to 2,090 units in November from 5,931 in the same month last year, the Customs Department said on Thursday.
It did not give a reason for the fall in November imports of passenger cars.
Total tax collections on car imports in November was 1.43 billion baht ($57.2 million) compared with 3.24 billion baht in the same period last year, the department said in a statement.
European cars were the top imports with 1,536 units, and American cars ranked second with 313, it added.
